scope: All 26 residual standalone najprěd discourse adverbs: one in paper 45 and 25 in the base papers.
choice: Normalize najprěd/Najprěd to official najprvo/Najprvo, preserving capitalization.
motivation: All sites mean first or first of all. The selected type-1 form is the official cross-family bridge and the already established house form.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining najprěd leaves a zero-headword source doublet.
Prvo alone loses the first-of-all discourse function.
Raněje or naprěd would change the meaning to earlier or in advance.
